categories.main_business_segments: The company primarily operates in the research, development, production, and sales of recombinant proteins including target and factor proteins, recombinant antibodies, enzymes, and reagents. It also provides comprehensive application solutions for biopharmaceuticals, in vitro diagnostics, mRNA vaccine drugs, and life science basic research. Additionally, the company offers contract research organization (CRO) services including customized protein and antibody expression, vaccine-related technical services, and technology package transfers.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company has developed 23 core technologies integrated into 7 comprehensive technology platforms covering molecular biology, cell biology, structural biology, immunology, enzymology, biochemistry, synthetic biology, genetic engineering, and cell engineering. Key platforms include the Legotein® protein engineering platform, protein molecular evolution platform, antibody development platform, computer-aided protein expression design (CAPE) platform, large-scale production and quality control platform, protein formulation design platform, and application technology development platform. Production involves high-density fermentation with GMP-grade processes, advanced protein design, expression, purification, and quality control systems ensuring high purity, activity, and batch consistency.
categories.primary_customers_markets: The company's key customers are global biopharmaceutical companies, vaccine manufacturers, in vitro diagnostic enterprises, and research institutions engaged in life sciences. It serves industries including biopharmaceutical drug development (antibody drugs, cell and gene therapy, ADCs), mRNA vaccine production, molecular and immunodiagnostics, and basic life science research. The company supports over 3,000 customers worldwide, including leading mRNA vaccine producers and cell therapy developers.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China with headquarters and production facilities in Suzhou and subsidiaries in Shanghai and Heze. It also has wholly-owned subsidiaries in the United States (New Jersey and California) to support international sales and services. Domestic sales dominate revenue, with ongoing efforts to expand overseas markets through enhanced marketing and sales teams.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates upstream in the biopharmaceutical and life sciences supply chain as a key raw material and reagent supplier. It provides foundational recombinant proteins, enzymes, antibodies, and related technical services that enable downstream drug development, vaccine production, diagnostics, and research applications. It also offers CRO services supporting product development and manufacturing processes.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategically, the company focuses on bottom-layer innovation in protein technology and application solutions to empower the biopharmaceutical industry. It emphasizes front-end R&D in mRNA vaccine raw materials, biopharmaceuticals, diagnostics, and life science research reagents. The company invests heavily in developing new protein structures, multi-transmembrane proteins, mRNA synthesis enzymes, and quality control technologies. It aims to provide full-process application solutions, expand product pipelines, enhance GMP production capabilities, and support downstream clinical approvals. Talent acquisition and global integration of life science technologies are also key priorities.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through direct sales of recombinant proteins, antibodies, enzymes, and reagents to industrial and research customers. The company also earns income from CRO services including customized protein expression, vaccine candidate development, and technology package transfers. Sales are conducted mainly via direct sales to large industrial clients and supplemented by distributors for smaller or research-focused customers. Revenue recognition occurs upon delivery and customer acceptance of products or services.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company holds a leading position in the domestic mRNA raw material enzyme market with approximately 39.8% market share in 2021, ranking first among Chinese manufacturers. It competes with international brands dominating the global recombinant protein reagent market, such as R&D Systems and PeproTech. The company differentiates itself through integrated technology platforms, comprehensive full-process solutions, and strong customer relationships across multiple biopharmaceutical and diagnostic segments. It is recognized as a national specialized and innovative 'Little Giant' enterprise and a manufacturing 'single champion'.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2023, the company reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 153.19 million, a 42.09% decrease from the previous year, and net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 12.84 million, down 85.84%. The decline was mainly due to reduced pandemic-related product demand and increased R&D and marketing expenses. Despite the downturn, conventional business revenue grew by 14.68%. The company maintains total assets of about RMB 2.3 billion and net assets of RMB 2.19 billion. R&D investment increased significantly to 29.24% of revenue, reflecting a strategic focus on innovation.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes its core competitive advantage in bottom-layer protein innovation and integrated full-process application solutions tailored to diverse downstream needs. Its proprietary technology platforms enable design and production of high-purity, high-activity recombinant proteins, including challenging multi-transmembrane proteins and GMP-grade mRNA vaccine enzymes. The company offers stable, scalable supply with stringent quality control, supporting customers’ clinical development and regulatory approvals. Its comprehensive CRO services and technical support deepen customer engagement and enhance product development efficiency, positioning it as a trusted partner in the biopharmaceutical ecosystem.
